open-pdf-get-page-count.title: Open PDF and Get Page Count
open-pdf-get-page-count.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF file from disk using Aspose.Pdf.Document and retrieve the total number of pages.

open-pdf-from-filestream-and-save-copy.title: Open PDF from FileStream and Save to New File
open-pdf-from-filestream-and-save-copy.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF document from a FileStream using Aspose.Pdf and saving it to a new file with default settings.

open-encrypted-pdf-without-password.title: Open Encrypted PDF Without Password
open-encrypted-pdf-without-password.description: Demonstrates how to attempt opening a password‑protected PDF using Aspose.Pdf and handle the InvalidPasswordException when no password is supplied.

save-pdf-to-memorystream-and-write-to-fi.title: Save PDF to MemoryStream and Write to File
save-pdf-to-memorystream-and-write-to-fi.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, saving it into a MemoryStream, and then writing the stream to a physical file.

convert-pdf-to-pdfa1b.title: Convert PDF to PDF/A‑1b with Metadata Preservation
convert-pdf-to-pdfa1b.description: Shows how to load a PDF, convert it to PDF/A‑1b compliance while automatically preserving metadata, and save the resulting file using Aspose.Pdf.

convert-pdf-to-pdfx3.title: Convert PDF to PDF/X‑3 while Preserving Color Profiles
convert-pdf-to-pdfx3.description: Shows how to load a PDF, convert it to PDF/X‑3 compliance (keeping embedded color profiles), and save the resulting document.

encrypt-pdf-with-owner-user-passwords.title: Encrypt PDF with Passwords and Restrict Printing
encrypt-pdf-with-owner-user-passwords.description: Shows how to load a PDF, apply user and owner passwords, disable printing via permissions, and save the encrypted file using Aspose.Pdf.

decrypt-encrypted-pdf.title: Decrypt Encrypted PDF with User Password
decrypt-encrypted-pdf.description: Loads an encrypted PDF using the provided user password, removes its encryption, and saves an unprotected copy.

add-blank-page-to-pdf.title: Add Blank Page to PDF Document
add-blank-page-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading an existing PDF, appending a blank page, and saving the updated file using Aspose.Pdf.

insert-pdf-page-into-another-pdf.title: Insert PDF Page into Another PDF at Specific Position
insert-pdf-page-into-another-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading two PDF documents, extracting a page from the source PDF, and inserting it into the target PDF at a given position using Aspose.Pdf's Pages.Insert method.

remove-third-page-from-pdf.title: Remove Third Page from PDF
remove-third-page-from-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, delete the third page when present, and save the modified document.

split-multi-page-pdf-into-single-page-fi.title: Split PDF into Single-Page Files
split-multi-page-pdf-into-single-page-fi.description: Shows how to split a multi-page PDF into separate one-page PDF documents using Aspose.Pdf's Document class and the Pages.Add method within a loop.

batch-convert-pdfs-to-pdfa-1b.title: Batch Convert PDFs to PDF/A-1b
batch-convert-pdfs-to-pdfa-1b.description: Shows how to iterate through a folder of PDF files, convert each to PDF/A‑1b compliance with Aspose.Pdf, and save the converted files along with a conversion log.

encrypt-pdf-stream.title: Encrypt PDF from URL and Save to Stream
encrypt-pdf-stream.description: Downloads a PDF from a given URL, applies AES‑256 encryption with specified user and owner passwords, and writes the secured PDF to an output stream.

create-pdfx3-document-three-pages.title: Create PDF/X‑3 Document with Multiple Pages
create-pdfx3-document-three-pages.description: Shows how to create a new PDF, add three blank pages, convert it to PDF/X‑3 format, and save the resulting file.

update-pdf-title-metadata.title: Update PDF Title Metadata from Byte Array
update-pdf-title-metadata.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF from a byte array using a MemoryStream, modifying its Title metadata, and saving the updated document to disk.

incremental-append-page-to-pdf.title: Save PDF with Incremental Update
incremental-append-page-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates copying an existing PDF, opening it with a read/write stream, appending a blank page, and saving using Aspose.Pdf's incremental update mode to preserve the original content.

compress-pdf-default-settings.title: Compress PDF Using Default Settings
compress-pdf-default-settings.description: Loads a PDF file and saves it with Aspose.Pdf's default compression, then compares the original and compressed file sizes.

export-pdf-pages-to-separate-files.title: Export PDF Pages to Separate Files
export-pdf-pages-to-separate-files.description: Shows how to split a PDF into individual page PDFs using Aspose.Pdf by loading the source document, extracting each page, and saving each as a separate file.

load-pdf-memorystream-set-version-save.title: Load PDF from MemoryStream and Set PDF Version to 1.4
load-pdf-memorystream-set-version-save.description: The example creates a PDF in memory, loads it from a MemoryStream, converts the document to PDF version 1.4 using Document.Convert, and saves the result to the file system.

encrypt-pdf-form-filling-permission.title: Encrypt PDF with Form Fill Permission Only
encrypt-pdf-form-filling-permission.description: Demonstrates how to encrypt a PDF, allow only form filling, and disable content extraction using Aspose.Pdf.

create-pdfa1b-with-text-paragraph.title: Create PDF/A‑1b Document with Text Paragraph
create-pdfa1b-with-text-paragraph.description: Demonstrates how to create a PDF, add a text paragraph, convert it to PDF/A‑1b compliance, and save the resulting file.

rotate-second-pdf-page-90-degrees.title: Rotate Second Page of PDF by 90 Degrees
rotate-second-pdf-page-90-degrees.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, rotate the second page 90° clockwise, and save the modified document.

update-pdf-author-metadata.title: Update PDF Author Metadata
update-pdf-author-metadata.description: Loads a PDF file, replaces its Author metadata with the current user name, and saves the updated document.

batch-encrypt-pdfs-in-directory.title: Batch Encrypt PDFs with a User Password
batch-encrypt-pdfs-in-directory.description: Shows how to encrypt every PDF in a folder using Aspose.Pdf, applying the same user and owner passwords and saving the encrypted files to a separate directory.

batch-decrypt-encrypted-pdfs.title: Batch Decrypt Encrypted PDFs with Owner Password
batch-decrypt-encrypted-pdfs.description: Demonstrates iterating over a folder of password‑protected PDF files, opening each with a shared owner password, removing encryption, and saving an unprotected copy.

convert-pdf-to-pdfa-1b.title: Convert PDF to PDF/A-1B Compliance
convert-pdf-to-pdfa-1b.description: Loads a PDF file, converts it to PDF/A‑1B compliance using Aspose.Pdf, and saves the compliant document.

download-pdf-from-url-and-save.title: Download PDF from URL and Save Locally with Aspose.Pdf
download-pdf-from-url-and-save.description: Demonstrates how to download a PDF file from a network URL using HttpClient, load it into an Aspose.Pdf Document from a stream, and save it to the local file system.

encrypt-pdf-aes256-no-print.title: Encrypt PDF with AES‑256 and Verify No Printing Permission
encrypt-pdf-aes256-no-print.description: Demonstrates how to apply AES‑256 encryption to a PDF with all permissions disabled (no printing) and then verifies the security settings by opening the encrypted file with the user password.

update-pdf-version-to-1-5-incremental-sa.title: Change PDF Version to 1.5 and Save with Incremental Update
update-pdf-version-to-1-5-incremental-sa.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, converting it to PDF version 1.5 using Document.Convert, and saving it with an incremental update by writing to a read/write stream.

update-pdf-passwords.title: Update User Password of a Protected PDF
update-pdf-passwords.description: Shows how to open a password‑protected PDF with Aspose.Pdf, change its user password while preserving the owner password, and save the document with new encryption settings.

split-pdf-at-page-10.title: Split PDF into Two Parts at Page Ten
split-pdf-at-page-10.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, extract pages before and after a specified split point, and save each segment as separate PDF files with descriptive names.

set-pdf-document-title-and-verify.title: Set PDF Document Title and Verify
set-pdf-document-title-and-verify.description: Shows how to open a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, assign a new Title metadata value, save the file, and then reopen it to confirm the title was updated.

convert-pdf-to-pdfx3-cmyk.title: Convert PDF to PDF/X‑3 with CMYK Color Space
convert-pdf-to-pdfx3-cmyk.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, converting it to PDF/X‑3 format and optionally forcing CMYK color space, then saving the result and writing a conversion log.

batch-convert-pdfs-to-pdfa-with-csv-repo.title: Batch Convert PDFs to PDF/A-1b with CSV Logging
batch-convert-pdfs-to-pdfa-with-csv-repo.description: Demonstrates converting a collection of PDF files to PDF/A-1b format using Aspose.Pdf and recording each conversion's outcome in a CSV file.

rotate-pdf-page-3-180-degrees.title: Rotate Page 3 of PDF from Byte Array
rotate-pdf-page-3-180-degrees.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF from a byte array, rotating the third page by 180 degrees, and saving the modified document.

encrypt-pdf-with-user-password-only.title: Encrypt PDF with User Password and Restricted Permissions
encrypt-pdf-with-user-password-only.description: Demonstrates encrypting a PDF using a user password with AES‑256 encryption and setting permissions to allow printing while disabling editing and copying.

encrypt-pdf-allow-form-filling.title: Encrypt PDF Allowing Only Form Filling
encrypt-pdf-allow-form-filling.description: Demonstrates how to open a PDF, restrict permissions to form filling only, encrypt it with AES‑256, and save the protected file using Aspose.Pdf.

split-pdf-into-individual-pages.title: Batch Split PDF into Single-Page PDFs in Separate Folders
split-pdf-into-individual-pages.description: Loads a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, extracts each page into its own Document, and saves each page as a PDF inside a dedicated folder.

encrypt-pdf-rc4-128-verify-size.title: Encrypt PDF with 128‑bit RC4 and Verify Size Increase
encrypt-pdf-rc4-128-verify-size.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, applying 128‑bit RC4 encryption with specific permissions, saving the encrypted file, and checking that the file size grows slightly after encryption.

batch-encrypt-pdfs.title: Batch Encrypt PDFs with User Passwords from Config
batch-encrypt-pdfs.description: Demonstrates reading a configuration file to apply individual user passwords to multiple PDFs, encrypting each file with Aspose.Pdf and saving the encrypted versions.

convert-pdf-to-pdfx3-preserve-icc.title: Convert PDF to PDF/X‑3 with ICC Profile Preservation
convert-pdf-to-pdfx3-preserve-icc.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, converting it to PDF/X‑3 while retaining embedded ICC color profiles for accurate printing, and saving the converted file.

batch-convert-pdf-to-pdfa-with-report.title: Batch Convert PDFs to PDF/A-1b with Compression
batch-convert-pdf-to-pdfa-with-report.description: Demonstrates how to convert multiple PDF files to PDF/A-1b format with file-size optimization and generate a summary conversion report.

add-custom-xmp-metadata-to-pdf.title: Add Custom XMP Metadata to PDF
add-custom-xmp-metadata-to-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF, register a namespace, add custom XMP metadata properties, and save the document while preserving the metadata.

encrypt-pdf-owner-password-only.title: Encrypt PDF with Owner Password Only
encrypt-pdf-owner-password-only.description: Shows how to encrypt a PDF using Aspose.Pdf by setting an owner password, leaving the user password empty, and applying restrictive permissions.

rotate-all-pdf-pages-180-degrees.title: Rotate All PDF Pages 180 Degrees
rotate-all-pdf-pages-180-degrees.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, rotate each page by 180 degrees, and save the modified document.

encrypt-pdf-aes128-verify-print-permissi.title: Encrypt PDF with AES‑128 and Verify Print Permission
encrypt-pdf-aes128-verify-print-permissi.description: Demonstrates how to encrypt a PDF using AES‑128, set high‑quality printing permission, and then verify the encryption settings by reopening and checking the permissions.

batch-encrypt-pdfs-with-deterministic-pa.title: Batch Encrypt PDFs with Filename‑Based Passwords
batch-encrypt-pdfs-with-deterministic-pa.description: Shows how to encrypt multiple PDF files using Aspose.Pdf, generating a deterministic password from each file name and recording the filename‑password pairs in a secure log.

batch-split-pdf-by-page-ranges.title: Batch Split PDF into Sections Using Page Ranges
batch-split-pdf-by-page-ranges.description: Demonstrates how to read page‑range definitions from a text file and split a source PDF into multiple section PDFs using Aspose.Pdf.

encrypt-pdf-form-fill-permission.title: Encrypt PDF with User Password and Restrict to Form Filling
encrypt-pdf-form-fill-permission.description: Demonstrates how to encrypt a PDF using a user and owner password, allow only form‑filling permissions, and disable printing with Aspose.Pdf.

set-pdf-metadata-author-title-subject.title: Set PDF Document Metadata and Verify with Aspose.Pdf
set-pdf-metadata-author-title-subject.description: Shows how to open a PDF, set its author, title, and subject metadata, save the file, and re-open it to verify the updated information using Aspose.Pdf.

encrypt-pdf-rc4-no-copy-permission.title: Encrypt PDF with RC4 and Disable Copying
encrypt-pdf-rc4-no-copy-permission.description: Demonstrates encrypting a PDF using RC4 128‑bit, setting no permissions to block copying, and programmatically verifying the security settings.

convert-pdf-to-pdfa1b-with-font-embeddin.title: Convert PDF to PDF/A-1b with Font Embedding
convert-pdf-to-pdfa1b-with-font-embeddin.description: Shows how to load a PDF, convert it to PDF/A‑1b compliance while embedding missing fonts, and save the resulting file using Aspose.Pdf.
